title: Italy's ACN October summary: 394 incidents, hacktivist campaign and PHP2Shell exposure
summary: ACN's October operational summary reports 394 incidents. A hacktivist campaign that began on 5 October logged 249 events, with impact confirmed in circa l'8% of cases. On PHP2Shell, of oltre 740.000 PHP services detected in Italy, circa 285.000 used potentially vulnerable versions.
plain: Italy's cyber agency says October had 394 incidents, a hacktivist campaign with impact in circa l'8% of its events, and circa 285.000 PHP services on potentially vulnerable versions.
exec: ACN's October figures include circa 285.000 PHP services on potentially vulnerable versions out of oltre 740.000 detected in Italy.

evidence.quote: Anche gli incidenti sono risultati in aumento: 394 rispetto a 271.
a fronte di 249 eventi censiti, sono stati accertati impatti soltanto in circa l'8% dei casi
Su oltre 740.000 servizi PHP rilevati in Italia, circa 285.000 utilizzavano versioni potenzialmente vulnerabili

validation.note: ACN's own summary, relayed by Cybersecurity360.
